meanings.en: involving or relating to sex between a married person and someone who is not their spouse
meanings.exampleEn: He had an adulterous affair with his colleague.
meanings.exampleTr: İş arkadaşıyla zina niteliğinde bir ilişki yaşadı.

meanings.en: a person who gives advice, usually professionally
meanings.exampleEn: She works as a financial advisor at the bank.
meanings.exampleTr: Bankada finansal danışman olarak çalışıyor.

meanings.en: friendly and easy to talk to
meanings.exampleEn: The new manager is an affable man who everyone likes.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni müdür herkesin sevdiği cana yakın bir adam.

meanings.en: a natural liking for or connection with someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: She has a strong affinity with animals.
meanings.exampleTr: Hayvanlara karşı güçlü bir yakınlığı var.

meanings.en: a statement declaring that something is true
meanings.exampleEn: The court required an affirmation of his testimony.
meanings.exampleTr: Mahkeme, ifadesinin doğrulanmasını istedi.

meanings.tr: (hastalık, sıkıntı) musallat olmak, acı vermek, kıvrandırmak
meanings.en: to cause someone to suffer from a problem or illness
meanings.exampleEn: A rare disease afflicted thousands of people in the region.
meanings.exampleTr: Nadir bir hastalık bölgedeki binlerce insana musallat oldu.

meanings.en: the process of planting trees to create a forest
meanings.exampleEn: The government launched a large afforestation project to combat climate change.
meanings.exampleTr: Hükümet, iklim değişikliğiyle mücadele için büyük bir ağaçlandırma projesi başlattı.

meanings.tr: adı geçen, yukarıda belirtilen, söz konusu
meanings.en: referred to previously in the same text or speech
meanings.exampleEn: The aforementioned conditions must be met before signing the contract.
meanings.exampleTr: Sözleşme imzalanmadan önce yukarıda belirtilen koşullar sağlanmalıdır.

meanings.en: in a new or different way; again from the beginning
meanings.exampleEn: After the failure, they decided to start afresh.
meanings.exampleTr: Başarısızlığın ardından yeniden başlamaya karar verdiler.

meanings.en: repeatedly; many times
meanings.exampleEn: I told him again and again to be careful.
meanings.exampleTr: Ona defalarca dikkatli olmasını söyledim.

meanings.en: a range of ages considered as a group
meanings.exampleEn: This product is designed for people in the 18-25 age bracket.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu ürün 18-25 yaş aralığındaki kişiler için tasarlandı.

meanings.en: angry or violent feelings or behavior toward another
meanings.exampleEn: The dog showed signs of aggression toward strangers.
meanings.exampleTr: Köpek yabancılara karşı saldırganlık belirtileri gösterdi.

meanings.en: a person or country that attacks first or starts a fight
meanings.exampleEn: The invading country was condemned as the aggressor.
meanings.exampleTr: İşgalci ülke saldırgan taraf olarak kınandı.

meanings.en: able to move quickly and easily; quick-thinking
meanings.exampleEn: The gymnast was remarkably agile.
meanings.exampleTr: Jimnastikçi son derece çevikti.

meanings.en: a state of anxiety or nervous excitement
meanings.exampleEn: She paced the room in a state of agitation.
meanings.exampleTr: Huzursuzluk içinde odada bir aşağı bir yukarı yürüdü.

meanings.en: (of a ship) on or onto the bottom in shallow water
meanings.exampleEn: The ship ran aground on a sandbank.
meanings.exampleTr: Gemi bir kum bankına oturdu.

meanings.en: containing no alcohol
meanings.exampleEn: They offer several alcohol-free drinks at the party.
meanings.exampleTr: Partide birkaç alkolsüz içecek sunuyorlar.

meanings.en: the state of being watchful and quick to notice things
meanings.exampleEn: Coffee helps improve alertness in the morning.
meanings.exampleTr: Kahve sabahları uyanıklığı artırmaya yardımcı olur.

meanings.en: a being from another world
meanings.exampleEn: The film is about an alien who visits Earth.
meanings.exampleTr: Film, Dünya'yı ziyaret eden bir uzaylı hakkında.

meanings.en: a foreigner, especially one who is not a legal resident
meanings.exampleEn: The law affects illegal aliens living in the country.
meanings.exampleTr: Yasa, ülkede yaşayan yasadışı yabancıları etkiliyor.

meanings.en: the feeling of being isolated or estranged from others
meanings.exampleEn: Long working hours can lead to a sense of alienation.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzun çalışma saatleri yabancılaşma hissine yol açabilir.

meanings.en: having a pH greater than 7; the opposite of acidic
meanings.exampleEn: The soil in this area is highly alkaline.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu bölgedeki toprak oldukça alkali.

meanings.en: having a wide range of skills or abilities
meanings.exampleEn: He is an all-around athlete who excels in many sports.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok sporda başarılı, çok yönlü bir atlettir.

meanings.en: including everything or everyone
meanings.exampleEn: The company has an all-encompassing insurance policy.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirketin her şeyi kapsayan bir sigorta poliçesi var.

meanings.tr: çok yönlü kişi, her işi beceren
meanings.en: a person skilled in many different areas
meanings.exampleEn: As an all-rounder, she can handle both design and coding.
meanings.exampleTr: Çok yönlü biri olarak hem tasarım hem de kodlama yapabiliyor.

meanings.en: lasting or available throughout the whole year
meanings.exampleEn: The resort offers all-year activities for tourists.
meanings.exampleTr: Tesis, turistler için yıl boyu etkinlikler sunuyor.

meanings.en: a narrow passage between or behind buildings
meanings.exampleEn: The cat disappeared down a dark alley.
meanings.exampleTr: Kedi karanlık bir ara sokakta kayboldu.

meanings.tr: ima etmek, dolaylı olarak değinmek, üstü kapalı bahsetmek
meanings.en: to refer to something indirectly
meanings.exampleEn: She alluded to some problems but gave no details.
meanings.exampleTr: Bazı sorunlara ima etti ama ayrıntı vermedi.

meanings.en: the quality of being powerfully and mysteriously attractive
meanings.exampleEn: The allure of the big city drew many young people.
meanings.exampleTr: Büyük şehrin cazibesi birçok genci kendine çekti.

meanings.en: the state of being alone, without others
meanings.exampleEn: He enjoyed the aloneness of the quiet cabin.
meanings.exampleTr: Sessiz kulübenin yalnızlığından keyif aldı.

meanings.en: relating to or arranged in the order of the alphabet
meanings.exampleEn: The names are listed in alphabetic order.
meanings.exampleTr: İsimler alfabetik sırayla listelenmiştir.

meanings.en: a person who climbs high mountains
meanings.exampleEn: The experienced alpinist reached the summit at dawn.
meanings.exampleTr: Deneyimli dağcı zirveye şafak vakti ulaştı.

meanings.en: despite the fact that; even though
meanings.exampleEn: Although it was raining, we went for a walk.
meanings.exampleTr: Yağmur yağmasına rağmen yürüyüşe çıktık.

meanings.en: done in an unskilled or unprofessional way
meanings.exampleEn: The report looked amateurish and poorly organized.
meanings.exampleTr: Rapor acemice ve kötü düzenlenmiş görünüyordu.

meanings.en: a surprise attack from a hidden position
meanings.exampleEn: The soldiers were caught in an ambush.
meanings.exampleTr: Askerler bir pusuya düşürüldü.

meanings.en: a friendly and peaceful relationship
meanings.exampleEn: The two nations lived in amity for decades.
meanings.exampleTr: İki ulus onlarca yıl dostluk içinde yaşadı.

meanings.en: the standard unit for measuring electric current
meanings.exampleEn: The circuit can safely carry up to ten amperes.
meanings.exampleTr: Devre güvenle on ampere kadar akım taşıyabilir.

meanings.en: similar in some respects and therefore comparable
meanings.exampleEn: The human eye is analogous to a camera.
meanings.exampleTr: İnsan gözü bir kameraya benzer.

meanings.en: using logical reasoning to examine things in detail
meanings.exampleEn: She has an analytical mind and solves problems quickly.
meanings.exampleTr: Analitik bir zihni var ve sorunları hızlıca çözer.

meanings.en: a state of disorder due to absence of authority
meanings.exampleEn: The collapse of the government led to anarchy.
meanings.exampleTr: Hükümetin çökmesi anarşiye yol açtı.

meanings.en: strong hostility or hatred
meanings.exampleEn: There was deep animosity between the two rivals.
meanings.exampleTr: İki rakip arasında derin bir husumet vardı.

meanings.en: to take control of a territory and add it to one's own
meanings.exampleEn: The empire sought to annex the neighboring territory.
meanings.exampleTr: İmparatorluk komşu toprakları ilhak etmeye çalıştı.

meanings.tr: ek bina, ek yapı; ek belge
meanings.en: a building or section added to a larger one
meanings.exampleEn: The school built a new annex for science classes.
meanings.exampleTr: Okul, fen dersleri için yeni bir ek bina inşa etti.
